instructions: gmail is the scheduled Cloud Run job that copies every Workspace mailbox into a BigQuery table through domain-wide delegation. Its constitution is AGENTS.md, listed in files.json. Portfolio-wide rules arrive from the organization layer as [envision-*] records and are not restated here; this folder holds only rules local to gmail.

rules.rule: Removes the `SERVICE_ACCOUNT_FILE` entry from the deploy step's `env_vars` or the key mount from its `secrets` block; the action passes both as replacing flags, so the next deploy strips the delegation key and every scrape fails. Defined in `.github/workflows/deploy.yml`.

Adds `--allow-unauthenticated` or an `allUsers` or `allAuthenticatedUsers` binding, or removes `--no-allow-unauthenticated` or the 'Verify no public access' step, which would let unauthenticated callers start a job that reads every mailbox in the domain. Defined in `.github/workflows/deploy.yml`.

Adds or edits a `uses:` reference that points at a tag or branch instead of a full-length commit SHA; the organization's Actions policy rejects such a workflow before any step runs, so pushes to main stop deploying without a failed step to notice. Defined in the pinning comment and `uses:` lines of `.github/workflows/deploy.yml`.

Changes the 'Update Cloud Scheduler (OIDC)' step to delete or recreate the job, drops `--oidc-service-account-email` or `--oidc-token-audience`, or moves the step ahead of the deploy; the service rejects unauthenticated calls, and the step runs last and only updates or creates so a failed deploy never leaves the scrape without a scheduler job. Defined in `.github/workflows/deploy.yml`.

Replaces the key-file credentials in `get_service_account_credentials` with plain Application Default Credentials, or drops a `with_subject` call, without adding a signer for domain-wide delegation; plain ADC cannot impersonate a mailbox, so every scrape returns `status: failed` while the GET health check stays green. Defined in `gmail_scraper.py`.

Adds a scope to `GMAIL_SCOPES` or `ADMIN_SCOPES` beyond `gmail.readonly` and `admin.directory.user.readonly`, or a Gmail API call that sends, modifies, labels, trashes or deletes mail; the delegation grant listed in `README_CLOUDRUN.md` covers only those read-only scopes, so a new scope fails token minting for every mailbox. Defined in `gmail_scraper.py`.

Adds, renames or removes a key in the row built by `process_message` without the same change to the `SchemaField` list in `ensure_table_exists`, the DDL in `ensure_alloydb_table`, the row mapping in `backfill_alloydb` and the schema table in `README_CLOUDRUN.md`; `ensure_table_exists` never alters an existing table and `insert_to_bigquery` logs insert errors and returns 0 instead of raising, so mismatched rows are dropped silently. Defined in `gmail_scraper.py`.

Removes or bypasses the per-user `message_id` skip that `get_existing_message_ids` feeds into `scrape_user_emails`; streaming inserts do not deduplicate, the incremental `after:` cursor is truncated to whole seconds and can re-list boundary messages, and `incremental: false` rescrapes rely on the skip alone, so dropping it writes duplicate rows. Defined in `gmail_scraper.py`.

Adds a Python module that `main.py` or `gmail_scraper.py` imports without a matching `COPY` line in `Dockerfile`, or replaces the named copies with `COPY . .` or a copy of a key or env file; the runtime stage copies named files only, so a missing module crashes the container on start and a broad copy can bake a local key file into the image. Defined in `Dockerfile`.

Adds a `print`, log call, error string or HTTP response field that carries message content or address headers (`body_text`, `body_snippet`, `subject`, `from_address`, `to_address`, `cc_address`, `bcc_address`) or a whole row; rows hold full mail for every mailbox in the domain, stdout lands in Cloud Logging and `main.py` returns results to the caller. Defined in `process_message` in `gmail_scraper.py`.
